text:
sam_sre: Heads-up: starting ~12:04 UTC we're seeing a spike of 502/504s for hosted inference in eu-west2-a. Affected customers report auth timeouts and token retries. Packet captures show short microbursts to ASN 64512 upstream.

deploy-bot: Alert: gw-eu-west2-a health checks failing, auto-failover attempted (runbooks/egress).

leo_network: Observed on-host nic0 tx drops + retransmits. `ethtool -S` shows queue drops on the egress interface. Provider BGP logs show partial withdraws on the primary uplink.

irene_prod: Customer CS-1123 called at 12:06 UTC — they hit our hosted API, saw 502s for ~6 minutes and many retries; provided curl trace with `504 Gateway Read Timeout`.

maria_support: Can we get an immediate mitigation for customers? Also see a billing spike from retry storms in the last 10m.

owen_engineer: Short term workaround: route affected traffic to eu-west2-b or dedicated pools. I can push a temporary upstream blackhole for the flaky peer if agreed.

sam_sre: Repro steps for infra: to mimic microbursts run `ping -f -s 1200 <provider-ip>` from an egress host — you'll see 0–2% burst loss; `ss -s` and `netstat -s` show retransmits. Also check `tc -s qdisc` for drops.

leo_network: Provider TAC confirms a linecard causing short transmit bursts when under bursty load. They're scheduling a replace but no ETA. We're attempting an alternate peering via peering-east-uplink.

irene_prod: Action items: 1) set routing policy to prefer eu-west2-b for hosted API 2) reduce auto-retries on client SDKs for 5 minutes 3) notify impacted customers. Maria, can you handle comms?

maria_support: On it. Drafting note: transient upstream network provider issue caused intermittent 502/504s; mitigation: failover to another AZ & recommend retry backoff. Offering credit for request duplication. Posting to #support_updates and contacting top 3 customers directly.

sam_sre: Applied soft-failover policy rp-47 -> prefer eu-west2-b. Metrics: 70% reduction in 5xx within 2 minutes. Still seeing sporadic blips during route convergence.

owen_engineer: Added temporary 250ms circuit-breaker on auth-gateway outbound calls to reduce connection churn and disabled client aggressive retries via feature-flag for 10m.

leo_network: Longer term: increase NIC tx queue (`txqueuelen`), enable pacing (fq_codel/tcp pacing), and get provider to replace the affected linecard. We'll capture a postmortem with packet captures and kernel counters.

maria_support: :thumbsup: Customers updated; CS-1123 marked resolved after failover and credit issued. Logging follow-up for billing reconciliation.

sam_sre: Closing notes: create an alert for >3% pkt loss on AZ egress sustained for 2m; add a dashboard tile for egress queue drops. I'll open the incident PR with timeline and attach pcaps. Great work, team.
